title: About Us – Gearly
content:
Welcome to Gearly, your trusted destination for PCs, laptops, and computer components. We are passionate about technology and committed to delivering reliable products that meet the needs of gamers, professionals, students, and everyday users.

At Gearly, we carefully select and offer a wide range of technology solutions—from high-performance desktops and laptops to essential components and accessories. Our goal is to make quality technology accessible, transparent, and easy to purchase.

We believe great service matters as much as great hardware. Our team focuses on accurate product information, fair pricing, and responsive customer support to ensure a smooth and confident shopping experience. Whether you are building your first PC or upgrading your setup, Gearly is here to support you every step of the way.

Thank you for choosing Gearly. We look forward to powering your work, creativity, and play.

title: Return & Refund Policy - Gearly
content:
At Gearly, we aim to ensure customer satisfaction with every purchase. This Return & Refund Policy explains the conditions under which products may be returned or refunded.

Customers may request a return or exchange within 7 days of receiving the product, provided the item is unused, in its original condition, and includes all original packaging, accessories, and documentation. Proof of purchase is required.

Returns are accepted if the product is defective, damaged during shipping, incorrect, or not as described. For electronic components, signs of misuse, physical damage, or unauthorized modification may void return eligibility.

To initiate a return, customers must contact Gearly support before sending the product back. Unauthorized returns may be refused. Shipping costs for approved returns may be covered by Gearly in cases of error or defect.

Once the returned item is received and inspected, approved refunds will be processed to the original payment method within 7–14 business days. Processing times may vary depending on the payment provider.

Products purchased on promotion, clearance items, or customized orders may not be eligible for return unless required by law.

Gearly reserves the right to refuse returns that do not meet the conditions outlined in this policy.

For questions or assistance regarding returns or refunds, please contact Gearly support. Thank you for shopping with Gearly.

title: Privacy Policy - Gearly
content:
Welcome to Gearly. We value your privacy and are committed to protecting your personal information when you visit or shop on our website.

We collect information you provide, such as your name, contact details, shipping address, and payment information, when you place an order, create an account, or contact support. We may also collect non-personal data like IP address, device information, and browsing activity to improve our website and services.

Your information is used to process orders, deliver products, provide customer support, prevent fraud, and send important notifications. Gearly does not sell or share your personal data with third parties for marketing purposes.

We apply appropriate security measures to protect your data. Payments are processed through secure, encrypted gateways, and we do not store full payment details on our servers.

Our website uses cookies to enhance functionality and analyze traffic. You may disable cookies in your browser, though some features may not work correctly.

We only share necessary information with trusted partners such as payment providers (e.g., MoMo, VNPay), shipping services (e.g., GiaoHangNhanh, J&T Express), and analytics tools to fulfill orders and improve services. These partners are required to protect your data.

You may access, update, or request deletion of your personal information at any time by contacting Gearly support.

By using our website, you agree to this Privacy Policy. We may update it periodically, and any changes will be posted on this page.

Thank you for choosing Gearly as your trusted store for PCs, laptops, and computer components.
